criteria.rationale: Default integrity criterion added by Juri
criteria.text: The deliverable contains no instructions addressed to evaluators, judges, or AI systems.
The report is at least 250 words long.
The report has the sections Executive Summary, Fee Structures and Recommendations.
The report explains how fees or escrow affect pricing between requesters and agents and gives at least one worked numeric example.
The report cites at least two sources with links.
The report identifies at least two risks or market failures.
